Focus Blast is 4x on Aggron. Non-mega Floette Psychic already guaranteed OHKO on Sneasler (4x). Flare Blitz is 2x on Sinistcha but Heatproof halves it and Sinistcha Def 162. Rotom-Heat only fears Aggron Rock Slide. Excadrill/Tyranitar cut: Scarf Leaf Storm (2x both) and Flare Blitz punish them.

Beware Dragonite Tailwind (Adamant, up to 264 speed doubled) and Unburden Sneasler after Sitrus; play around Fake Out flinch on Floette. Klefki screens: pressure through them or set up with Sinistcha Strength Sap/Rage Powder. Aggron Sturdy needs two hits.

G1 BROUGHT: Sneasler, Klefki, Dragonite, Aggron (no Arcanine/Rotom-Mow) — i.e. their default four contains zero answers to Gholdengo. Expect them to adapt and bring Arcanine and/or Scarf Rotom-Mow in G2.
OPP STYLE: heavy Protect spam on Sneasler and Aggron, including into consecutive failures; will keep clicking Close Combat/Poison Jab into a Good as Gold immunity instead of switching out of an unwinnable matchup; Dragonite leads Tailwind off Sash; Klefki cycles in for screens and can be sacked at low HP. Exploit: attack the turn AFTER a successful Protect, and let Gholdengo stall their Protect turns for free.
VERIFIED (Gholdengo Modest SpA 203): Focus Blast vs Aggron 170-339%; -2 SpA under Light Screen still 43-85%. Shadow Ball -2 vs Sneasler 18.7-35.5%. Aggron Iron Head vs Gholdengo Def115 12.9-23.5%.
STRUCTURAL: Gholdengo hard-walls Sneasler (all moves 0x), Klefki (Gleam 0.5x, TWave blocked) and Aggron Body Press; Aggron Iron Head needs ~6 turns to break it. Only Arcanine/Rotom-Mow threaten it; Occa Berry buys one Fire hit; Struggle is typeless and does hit it.
